LESSON: PLANTS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Resources in Our Environment
Topic 3.2: Plants
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Plants, part of Resources in Our Environment in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why are plants important in the environment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Plants together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Responsibility: learner embraces hard work when they complete assigned tasks as they engage in kitchen garden creating activities

at school.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Safety: Learner enhances safety skills when handling different plants in the environment during nature walk.

Creating a kitchen garden draws knowledge from concepts of measurement (length) in Mathematical Activities.

Approved support learning materials, different plants, resource person, digital devices with assistive technology, print and braille
